def score(program: str) -> float:
    w = program.split()
    n = len(program)
    v = len(set(w)) / (len(w) + 1) + program.count("\n") / 40 + n / (n + 900)
    v = v + 9 * program.count("(") / (n + 1)
    return v / 4 if v < 3.9 else 0.99

import math
import string

def score(program: str) -> float:
    x = 0
    for c in program:
        if not c.isspace():
            x = x + 1
    n = len(program)
    words = program.split()
    big = [w for w in words if len(w) > 8]
    bonus = len(big) / 99999999
    return x / (x + 3000) + n / 99999999 + bonus
